subject: [RFC PATCH 32/57] mm/collapse: move the file collapse into collapse.c

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch moves the file collapse mechanism from khugepaged.c to collapse.c, where it will be part of a unified collapse engine. The move includes functions related to file collapse, PTE-mapped THP recollapse, and table retraction. Five helpers are made static as they no longer have external callers. The patch is a pure motion of code with minimal changes, resulting in the removal of 1075 lines from khugepaged.c and addition of 1090 lines to collapse.c.
